name: Wadi Rum Protected Area
description: Wadi Rum, nicknamed the Valley of the Moon, is a vast desert in southern Jordan, about 60 km east of Aqaba. Sandstone and granite cliffs rise above red sand, cut by narrow gorges, natural arches and caverns. Thousands of rock carvings and inscriptions show people have lived here for 12,000 years, and visitors can explore it on guided tours, hikes and climbs.
